name: The Magicless Girl
source:
Rean Harper was born with a talent for magic, just like most of the people in this world. Of course, the minority are those born without it. And with diversity, comes discrimination. That's just how it works in this world, sadly. Rean understands that. He doesn't even think highly of his talent.

One day, on the beginning of spring break, he took a walk at school and met a magicless girl. This is a short story of their fateful encounter.

[From [url=https://adotryx.itch.io/the-magicless-girl]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
和这个世界上的大多数人一样，里恩·哈珀生来便拥有魔法天赋。当然，也有少数人生来没有。而有差异，就有歧视。令人遗憾的是，这个世界便是如此。里恩明白这一点，也并不觉得自己的天赋有多了不起。

春假刚开始的一天，他在学校散步时，遇见了一位没有魔法的女孩。这是一段关于两人命运般相遇的短篇故事。

[摘自[url=https://adotryx.itch.io/the-magicless-girl]itch.io[/url]]
